claims.proof_status: Self-contained prose proof; not independently reviewed or proof-assistant verified.
claims.priority_status: Finite application of established or elementary mathematical foundations. No claim that the underlying theorem family is newly discovered.
claims.assumptions: Two finite joint laws with total-variation error at most delta and an event positive under both.

claims.limits: Rare events can amplify approximation. An event impossible in one model requires separate treatment.

claims.title: The fixed-recipient covering criterion
claims.priority_status: Finite constraint intersection and set-cover characterization, integrated with source-access and recipient-cost contracts.
claims.assumptions: Finite case set, sender observation, fixed finite artifact catalogue, fixed recipient procedures and explicit execution bounds.
claims.conclusion: Existence exactly requires a nonempty intersection of acceptable artifacts for every sender fibre. The minimum common catalogue is a minimum hitting set.
claims.limits: A codebook count does not reduce physical artifact bytes without an installed index decoder. No claim of efficient minimum-cover search.

claims.title: A joint resource certificate for fixed recipients
claims.priority_status: Finite multiobjective dynamic programming with common implementation witnesses, not a general program-synthesis result.
claims.assumptions: Finite augmented state and experiment catalogue, bounded horizon, uniform admissibility, fixed decoder acceptance/cost tables, fixed nonnegative vector charges, explicit nonshared controller trees.
claims.conclusion: The recursive frontier characterizes attainable online vector budgets and total compiled controller records simultaneously, and supplies tree witnesses.
claims.limits: Not shortest-program synthesis, unbounded inquiry, learned models, or stochastic optimization. Fixed interpreter and offline design cost are separately charged.
